title: 受困的旅人
description: 在森林深处，你发现一个被树藤缠绕的受伤旅人。他看到你后投来求助的目光。

choices.label: 伸出援手
choices.description: 消耗体力帮助旅人脱困，获得一张通用绿色卡牌
choices.outcomeText: 旅人感激你的帮助，将家传的格挡技巧教给了你。
choices.description_en: Spend HP to free the traveler, gain a generic Uncommon card.
choices.outcomeText_en: The traveler thanks you and teaches you a practical guarding trick.

choices.label: 索要报酬
choices.description: 先谈好价钱再帮忙
choices.outcomeText: 旅人虽然有些不情愿，但还是付了金币作为酬劳。
choices.description_en: gain 8 gold
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Demand Payment and continue.

choices.label: 绕道走
choices.description: 多一事不如少一事
choices.outcomeText: 你绕过旅人继续前行。身后传来一声叹息。
choices.description_en: Leave without taking an effect
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Ignore and continue.

description_en: A wounded traveler lies by the roadside, seeking help.

title: 狼群包围
description: 夜色压低了树影，几双泛绿的眼睛从灌木后亮起，狼群正在收紧包围。

choices.label: 强行突围
choices.description: 硬闯狼群，夺下它们守着的猎物
choices.outcomeText: 你冲破狼群，身上添了几道伤口，也抢到了它们藏起的丰厚战利品。
choices.description_en: gain 28 gold, lose 8 HP
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Break Out and continue.

choices.label: 观察头狼
choices.description: 冒险观察狼群节奏，受轻伤并降低风险
choices.outcomeText: 你被狼爪擦伤，但也看清了狼群的扑击节奏，前方的危险气息稍稍散去。
choices.description_en: Risk watching the pack rhythm, lose a little HP and reduce risk.
choices.outcomeText_en: The wolves graze you, but you learn their rhythm and the danger ahead eases.

choices.label: 静待时机
choices.description: 不冒险，等狼群散去
choices.outcomeText: 你屏住呼吸，直到狼群追逐其他猎物离开。
choices.description_en: Leave without taking an effect
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Wait and continue.

description_en: Howling echoes through the trees as a pack of wolves encircles you.

title: 古树低语
description: 一棵巨大的古树在风中低语，树心里流动着温暖的金色光。

choices.label: 触摸树心
choices.description: 接受古树治愈
choices.outcomeText: 温暖的树液流过掌心，你的伤口缓缓愈合。
choices.description_en: restore 18 HP
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Touch Heart and continue.

choices.label: 聆听低语
choices.description: 耗费体力聆听低语，手牌上限 +1
choices.outcomeText: 古树的低语教会你如何整理思绪，你能掌控更多战术选择。
choices.description_en: lose 4 HP, increase hand limit by 1
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Listen and continue.

choices.label: 剥取树脂
choices.description: 获得金币，但会受伤并提高风险
choices.outcomeText: 树脂价值不菲，但古树痛苦的震颤引来了不安的气息。
choices.description_en: gain 16 gold, lose 5 HP, raise risk by 8
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Take Resin and continue.

description_en: An ancient tree seems to emanate a mysterious energy.

title: 古老祭坛
description: 在遗迹深处，你发现一座仍在运转的古老祭坛，散发着神秘的能量波动。

choices.label: 献上技能卡
choices.description: 失去5点生命，将一张初始技能卡献给祭坛，并获得本职业蓝色卡牌
choices.outcomeText: 祭坛吸收了卡牌的能量，吐出了一张更强大的技能卡！
choices.description_en: lose 5 HP, gain blue class card, remove a random basic card
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Offer Card and continue.

choices.label: 献上金币
choices.description: 向祭坛献上30金币，手牌上限 +1
choices.outcomeText: 祭坛吞下金币，闪耀出柔和的光芒，你的思绪从此变得更加敏捷。
choices.description_en: Offer 30 gold, hand limit +1
choices.outcomeText_en: The altar swallows the gold and glows softly; your mind is forever quicker.

choices.label: 离开
choices.description: 不打扰这座古老的祭坛
choices.outcomeText: 你默默离开，祭坛的光芒渐渐暗淡。
choices.description_en: Leave without taking an effect
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Leave and continue.

description_en: A mysterious shrine stands quietly in the ruins.

title: 机关宝箱
description: 一只刻满符文的宝箱静静躺在石台上，锁孔附近布满细小机关。

choices.label: 强行开启
choices.description: 硬吃机关，换取大量金币
choices.outcomeText: 机关刺入手臂，但宝箱里的金币足够弥补疼痛。
choices.description_en: gain 28 gold, lose 7 HP
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Force Open and continue.

choices.label: 仔细拆解
choices.description: 安全拆开机关，获得少量金币
choices.outcomeText: 你耐心拆掉机关，只找到一小袋金币。
choices.description_en: gain 10 gold
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Disarm and continue.

choices.label: 研究铭文
choices.description: 获得一张本职业绿色卡牌
choices.outcomeText: 铭文记载着失传技法，你将其转化成了新的技能。
choices.description_en: gain green class card
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Read Runes and continue.

choices.label: 离开宝箱
choices.description: 不碰可疑机关
choices.outcomeText: 你决定不让贪念战胜谨慎。
choices.description_en: Leave without taking an effect
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Leave and continue.

description_en: An ornate chest sits in the center of the chamber, clearly booby-trapped.

title: 破碎书库
description: 坍塌的书架间散落着残缺卷轴，空气中浮动着陈旧墨香。

choices.label: 翻阅战斗卷轴
choices.description: 获得一张本职业蓝色卡牌
choices.outcomeText: 卷轴中的招式残缺不全，但你补完了关键部分。
choices.description_en: gain blue class card
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Read Scroll and continue.

choices.label: 整理残页
choices.description: 熬夜钻研，失去生命，手牌上限 +1
choices.outcomeText: 你彻夜整理残卷，精神耗损，但战斗思路从此更加连贯。
choices.description_en: Lose HP, hand limit +1
choices.outcomeText_en: You sort the scrolls all night, draining yourself, but your combat flow is forever sharper.

choices.label: 出售古籍
choices.description: 获得金币，但风险上升
choices.outcomeText: 古籍卖了好价钱，也引来了其他探险者的注意。
choices.description_en: gain 18 gold, raise risk by 6
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Sell Books and continue.

description_en: Ancient tomes lie scattered across the floor of this collapsed library.

title: 神秘商人
description: 在熔岩流淌的峡谷中，一个兜帽商人向你展示他手中的发光物品。

choices.label: 接受交易
choices.description: 用15金币交换一张本职业稀有卡牌
choices.outcomeText: 商人将一张闪着微光的专属卡牌交到你手中，然后消失在热气中。
choices.description_en: Trade 15 gold for a rare class card.
choices.outcomeText_en: The merchant hands you a faintly glowing class card, then vanishes into the heat.

choices.label: 讨价还价
choices.description: 用10金币交换一张通用稀有卡牌，风险上升
choices.outcomeText: 经过一番唇枪舌战，你用10金币买下了这张卡牌，但商人把你的行踪卖给了附近的怪物。
choices.description_en: Trade 10 gold for a rare generic card, but raise risk.
choices.outcomeText_en: After sharp bargaining, you buy the card for 10 gold, but the merchant sells your trail to nearby monsters.

choices.label: 拒绝
choices.description: 不信任这个神秘商人
choices.outcomeText: 商人耸耸肩，消失在熔岩的热气中。
choices.description_en: Leave without taking an effect
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Refuse and continue.

description_en: A hooded figure tends a stall amidst the flames, offering exotic wares.

title: 熔岩锻炉
description: 一座被熔岩包围的锻炉仍在燃烧，铁砧上留着未冷却的火纹。

choices.label: 以血淬炼
choices.description: 失去生命，获得本职业紫色卡牌
choices.outcomeText: 血滴落在锻炉中，火焰铸出一张危险而强大的技能。
choices.description_en: lose 10 HP, gain purple class card
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Blood Temper and continue.

choices.label: 支付燃料费
choices.description: 花费10金币，随机升级一张卡
choices.outcomeText: 金币化作燃料，锻炉替你重铸了一张技能卡。
choices.description_en: Spend 10 gold to upgrade a random card.
choices.outcomeText_en: Your gold becomes fuel, and the forge reforges one of your skills.

choices.label: 收集余烬
choices.description: 收集可交易的炽热余烬，获得金币
choices.outcomeText: 你把温热的余烬收进耐火袋，它们在商人眼中颇有价值。
choices.description_en: Collect tradable hot embers and gain gold.
choices.outcomeText_en: You pack the warm embers into a fireproof pouch; merchants will value them.

description_en: A massive forge powered by flowing lava stands before you.

title: 小恶魔赌局
description: 一只小恶魔摇晃骰盅，咧嘴邀请你押上点什么。

choices.label: 赌金币
choices.description: 赢得一笔金币
choices.outcomeText: 小恶魔气得跺脚，你赢走了桌上的金币。
choices.description_en: gain 14 gold
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Gold Bet and continue.

choices.label: 赌体力
choices.description: 失去生命，获得随机通用卡
choices.outcomeText: 骰子滚出诡异点数，小恶魔递给你一张发烫的卡。
choices.description_en: lose 6 HP, gain blue generic card
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Body Bet and continue.

choices.label: 加大赌注
choices.description: 风险上升，获得大量金币
choices.outcomeText: 你赢了，但小恶魔的朋友们似乎记住了你的脸。
choices.description_en: gain 30 gold, raise risk by 12
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Raise Stakes and continue.

choices.label: 拒绝赌局
choices.description: 不和恶魔玩骰子
choices.outcomeText: 你无视挑衅，小恶魔悻悻收起骰盅。
choices.description_en: Leave without taking an effect
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Refuse and continue.

description_en: A mischievous imp challenges you to a game of chance.

title: 冰晶泉水
description: 一座被冰晶环绕的泉水在月光下闪耀，散发着纯净的魔法能量。

choices.label: 饮用泉水
choices.description: 失去6点生命，手牌上限 +1
choices.outcomeText: 刺骨的泉水带走一部分生命力，却让你的意识更加宽广。
choices.description_en: lose 6 HP, increase hand limit by 1
choices.outcomeText_en: The icy spring drains some vitality, but expands your focus.

choices.label: 收集冰晶
choices.description: 带走一些冰晶作为材料，获得金币
choices.outcomeText: 你收集了一些纯净的冰晶，这些深层寒晶能卖出不错的价钱。
choices.description_en: gain 22 gold
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Collect and continue.

choices.label: 在泉边冥想
choices.description: 感悟深层寒意，获得一张蓝色卡牌
choices.outcomeText: 在冥想中，你感受到了深层寒意的流动，一张更成熟的技能在脑海中成形。
choices.description_en: Attune to the deep frost and gain a blue card.
choices.outcomeText_en: In meditation, you feel deep frost flow through you as a stronger skill takes shape.

description_en: A pool of crystal-clear water shimmers with an otherworldly light.

title: 镜面冰湖
description: 冰湖平滑如镜，倒映出的不是现在，而是你未来某场战斗的影子。

choices.label: 凝视倒影
choices.description: 失去13点生命，获得本职业紫色卡牌
choices.outcomeText: 倒影中的招式刺痛了你的精神，却也被你牢牢记住。
choices.description_en: lose 13 HP, gain purple class card
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Stare and continue.

choices.label: 打碎冰面
choices.description: 获得金币
choices.outcomeText: 冰面下冻结着旧时代的货币，你把还能用的部分收了起来。
choices.description_en: gain 16 gold
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Break Ice and continue.

choices.label: 追随幻象
choices.description: 手牌上限 +1，但风险上升
choices.outcomeText: 幻象扩大了你的战术视野，也让未知的敌意靠近了你。
choices.description_en: raise risk by 8, increase hand limit by 1
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Follow Vision and continue.

description_en: The frozen lake surface is so smooth it reflects like a mirror.

title: 沉睡冰灵
description: 一只冰灵蜷缩在雪堆里，怀中抱着发光的霜晶。

choices.label: 轻声唤醒
choices.description: 冰灵以寒霜回应，失去生命，手牌上限 +1
choices.outcomeText: 冰灵醒来后向你点头，刺骨的寒意冻伤了你，却让清冷的思绪从此更有节奏。
choices.description_en: The spirit answers with frost, lose HP, hand limit +1
choices.outcomeText_en: The spirit nods as biting cold wounds you, yet your thoughts flow with cold clarity ever after.

choices.label: 偷取冰晶
choices.description: 获得金币，但失去生命
choices.outcomeText: 霜晶很值钱，但刺骨寒意也割伤了你的手。
choices.description_en: gain 22 gold, lose 5 HP
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Steal Crystal and continue.

choices.label: 献上金币
choices.description: 花15金币，恢复大量生命
choices.outcomeText: 冰灵收下金币，霜光化作清凉的治愈力量，迅速抚平你的伤口。
choices.description_en: Spend 15 gold to restore a large amount of HP.
choices.outcomeText_en: The spirit accepts the gold, and frostlight becomes soothing power that quickly mends your wounds.

description_en: A frost spirit slumbers within a block of ice.

title: 虚空裂隙
description: 一道撕裂空间的裂隙出现在你面前，从裂隙中传来低沉的低语。

choices.label: 进入裂隙
choices.description: 冒险进入虚空：损失生命，手牌上限 -1，但获得本职业橙色卡牌
choices.outcomeText: 你在虚空中经历了严峻的考验，带走了一张强大的本职业卡牌，但混沌压缩了你的手牌上限。
choices.description_en: Brave the void: lose 10 HP and -1 hand size, but gain an orange class card.
choices.outcomeText_en: You endured the void's trial and claimed a powerful class card, but chaos shrank your hand size.

choices.label: 尝试封印
choices.description: 用魔法能量封印裂隙
choices.outcomeText: 你成功封印了裂隙，虚空的能量凝结成了金币。
choices.description_en: gain 20 gold
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Seal and continue.

choices.label: 远离
choices.description: 直觉告诉你最好离远点
choices.outcomeText: 你转身离开，裂隙的低语渐渐远去。
choices.description_en: Leave without taking an effect
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Flee and continue.

description_en: A tear in reality itself, crackling with chaotic energy.

title: 低语神像
description: 扭曲神像从多个方向同时注视着你，声音直接钻进脑海。

choices.label: 接受低语
choices.description: 失去14点生命，获得本职业橙色卡牌
choices.outcomeText: 你接受了低语，它也在你的灵魂里留下灼痕。
choices.description_en: Lose 14 HP, gain an orange class card.
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Accept and continue.

choices.label: 献上金币
choices.description: 支付20金币，手牌上限 +1
choices.outcomeText: 神像吞下金币，吐出一段混乱但有用的战斗启示，你的掌控力从此更强。
choices.description_en: Spend 20 gold to gain +1 hand size.
choices.outcomeText_en: The idol swallows the gold and utters a chaotic but useful insight; your command grows stronger.

choices.label: 击碎神像
choices.description: 获得45金币，但风险大幅上升
choices.outcomeText: 神像碎裂成贵重晶片，远处却响起了回应的低语。
choices.description_en: Gain 45 gold, but risk rises sharply.
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Break Idol and continue.

choices.label: 闭耳离开
choices.description: 不回应低语
choices.outcomeText: 你压住杂念，离开了神像的视线。
choices.description_en: Leave without taking an effect
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Leave and continue.

description_en: An idol whispers temptations, promising power at a price.

title: 最后的营火
description: 一团微弱营火在混沌中燃烧，像是大战前最后的喘息。

choices.label: 包扎伤口
choices.description: 恢复生命
choices.outcomeText: 你借着火光处理伤口，疼痛终于缓和。
choices.description_en: restore 23 HP
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Bandage and continue.

choices.label: 整理牌组
choices.description: 移除一张随机基础卡，手牌上限 +1
choices.outcomeText: 你丢掉已经跟不上节奏的基础招式，牌组变得更紧凑。
choices.description_en: remove a random basic card, increase hand limit by 1
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Organize and continue.

choices.label: 搜刮余烬
choices.description: 获得金币
choices.outcomeText: 余烬里混着可交易的混沌结晶。
choices.description_en: gain 18 gold
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Take Embers and continue.

description_en: A dying campfire offers a moment of respite before the final battle.

title: 路边补给
description: 一只被遗落的小补给袋挂在路边，里面还有些能立刻派上用场的物资。

choices.label: 取走口粮
choices.description: 恢复少量生命
choices.outcomeText: 简单的口粮让你恢复了些体力。
choices.description_en: Restore a small amount of HP.
choices.outcomeText_en: The simple rations restore some of your strength.

choices.label: 翻找零钱
choices.description: 获得少量金币
choices.outcomeText: 你在袋底翻出几枚还能用的金币。
choices.description_en: Gain a small amount of gold.
choices.outcomeText_en: You find a few usable coins at the bottom of the bag.

choices.label: 不碰补给
choices.description: 继续前进
choices.outcomeText: 你没有动这份来路不明的补给。
choices.description_en: Move on.
choices.outcomeText_en: You leave the unknown supplies untouched.

description_en: A small abandoned supply pouch hangs by the road, still holding useful goods.

title: 静默路标
description: 一块旧路标斜插在地上，刻痕指向几条不同的安全小径。

choices.label: 选择安全路
choices.description: 降低风险
choices.outcomeText: 你沿着较安全的小径前进，周围的危险气息稍稍散去。
choices.description_en: Reduce risk.
choices.outcomeText_en: You follow the safer path, and the surrounding danger eases.

choices.label: 走近路
choices.description: 获得金币，但风险上升
choices.outcomeText: 近路旁散落着旧钱币，但也留下了新鲜的敌踪。
choices.description_en: Gain gold, but risk rises.
choices.outcomeText_en: Old coins lie near the shortcut, along with fresh enemy tracks.

description_en: An old waystone points toward several safer side paths.

title: 星光秘匣
description: 夜色中，一只映着星光的小匣子悄然开启，里面浮动着稀薄却纯净的力量。

choices.label: 汲取星光
choices.description: 失去少量生命，获得一张随机绿色卡牌
choices.outcomeText: 星光刺痛了你，也凝成一张可用的新技艺。
choices.description_en: Lose a little HP, gain a random Uncommon card.
choices.outcomeText_en: The starlight stings, then forms into a useful new technique.

choices.label: 收起星屑
choices.description: 获得金币
choices.outcomeText: 星屑很快黯淡，但在商人眼中仍颇有价值。
choices.description_en: Gain gold.
choices.outcomeText_en: The star shards fade quickly, but merchants will still value them.

choices.label: 合上秘匣
choices.description: 不冒险
choices.outcomeText: 你合上秘匣，让星光归于沉寂。
choices.description_en: Avoid the risk.
choices.outcomeText_en: You close the cache and let the starlight fade.

description_en: A small cache gleams with faint but pure starlight.

title: 技能升级祭坛
description: 你遇到了一座破旧但仍在运转的祭坛，可以将一张技能卡提升到新的层次。

choices.label: 升级初始技能
choices.description: 免费随机升级一张初始（白色）技能卡
choices.outcomeText: 祭坛发出柔和的光芒，你的一张初始技能卡被注入了新的力量！
choices.description_en: Freely upgrade a random starter (white) skill card.
choices.outcomeText_en: The altar glows softly, infusing one of your starter cards with new power!

choices.label: 献祭祈愿
choices.description: 花费10金币，随机升级任意一张可升级卡，并恢复8点生命
choices.outcomeText: 金币化作能量注入你的牌组，一张卡牌闪耀出更强的光芒，温暖的余晖也抚平了你的伤口。
choices.description_en: Spend 10 gold to upgrade any random upgradable card and heal 8 HP.
choices.outcomeText_en: Gold transmutes into power; one of your cards shines brighter while warm light soothes your wounds.

choices.label: 离开
choices.description: 留到下次再说
choices.outcomeText: 祭坛的能量缓缓沉寂。
choices.description_en: Leave without taking an effect
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Skip and continue.

description_en: An altar pulsating with mystical energy, offering card upgrades.

title: 流浪卡牌师
description: 一名披着旧斗篷的卡牌师坐在路边，面前摊着几张会自己翻面的卡。

choices.label: 购买技巧
choices.description: 支付金币，获得本职业蓝色卡牌
choices.outcomeText: 卡牌师收下金币，教给你一段实用技巧。
choices.description_en: spend 16 gold, gain blue class card
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Buy Lesson and continue.

choices.label: 切磋牌艺
choices.description: 失去生命，随机升级一张卡
choices.outcomeText: 切磋让你吃了点苦头，但也看清了一张卡的进阶方向。
choices.description_en: lose 6 HP, upgrade a random card
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Duel Cards and continue.

choices.label: 请教基础
choices.description: 获得随机通用绿色卡牌
choices.outcomeText: 基础并不花哨，却总能在关键时刻派上用场。
choices.description_en: gain green generic card
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Ask Basics and continue.

choices.label: 告辞
choices.description: 不打扰卡牌师
choices.outcomeText: 你向卡牌师点头致意，然后继续前进。
choices.description_en: Leave without taking an effect
choices.outcomeText_en: You choose Farewell and continue.

description_en: A mysterious card master offers to trade cards with you.

title: 心木林祭
description: 森林最深处，一株千年心木静静伫立，根系间流淌着浓郁到几乎成形的生命之力。机会只有一次。

choices.label: 与心木共鸣
choices.description: 失去生命，获得一张本职业蓝色卡牌
choices.outcomeText: 心木的意志涌入你的灵魂，一段实用而稀有的技艺在脑海中成形。
choices.description_en: Lose HP, gain a class Rare card.
choices.outcomeText_en: The heartwood's will floods your soul, and a practical rare art takes shape in your mind.

choices.label: 嫁接生命
choices.description: 献上28金币，永久提升生命上限 +10
choices.outcomeText: 心木的根须缠上你的身躯，你感到生命的容器被永久拓宽了。
choices.description_en: Offer 28 gold to permanently raise max HP by 10.
choices.outcomeText_en: The heartwood's roots coil around you; the vessel of your life is permanently widened.

choices.label: 修剪心木
choices.description: 移除一张随机基础卡，并随机升级一张卡
choices.outcomeText: 你剪去枯枝，心木以新生回报——牌组中冗余被剔除，一张技艺得到淬炼。
choices.description_en: Remove a random basic card and upgrade a random card.
choices.outcomeText_en: You cut away the dead wood; the heartwood rewards you—a redundant card is removed and one skill is refined.

choices.label: 默默离去
choices.description: 不打扰古老的存在
choices.outcomeText: 你向心木鞠躬，悄然退去。
choices.description_en: Do not disturb the ancient being.
choices.outcomeText_en: You bow to the heartwood and slip away.

description_en: Deep in the forest stands a thousand-year heartwood, its roots brimming with life force. The chance comes but once.

title: 遗迹核心宝库
description: 层层机关之后，一座古文明的核心宝库展现在眼前。守护符文仍在低鸣，但宝藏触手可及。

choices.label: 夺取遗物
choices.description: 失去10点生命，获得一张本职业紫色卡牌
choices.outcomeText: 符文的反噬撕裂了你的护甲，但遗物中的强大技艺已尽归你手。
choices.description_en: Lose 10 HP, gain a class Epic card.
choices.outcomeText_en: The wards lash back and tear your guard, but the relic's powerful art is now yours.

choices.label: 解析核心
choices.description: 花35金币，永久提升生命上限 +14
choices.outcomeText: 你解开了核心的运作之理，体魄被古老符文永久强化。
choices.description_en: Spend 35 gold to permanently raise max HP by 14.
choices.outcomeText_en: You unravel the core's principles; ancient runes permanently reinforce your body.

choices.label: 搜刮宝库
choices.description: 获得36金币，但风险大幅上升
choices.outcomeText: 你装满了行囊，但警报般的符文之声已传遍整片遗迹。
choices.description_en: Gain 36 gold, but risk rises sharply.
choices.outcomeText_en: You fill your pack, but the wards' alarm-like wail now echoes through the ruins.

choices.label: 全身而退
choices.description: 不冒险，安全离开
choices.outcomeText: 有些宝藏的代价太高，你选择全身而退。
choices.description_en: Play it safe and leave.
choices.outcomeText_en: Some treasures cost too much; you choose to withdraw intact.

description_en: Beyond layers of traps lies the core vault of a lost civilization. The wards still hum, but the treasure is within reach.

title: 永燃熔心
description: 烈焰之地的最深处，一团永不熄灭的熔心在咆哮。传说在此淬炼的技艺，足以焚尽一切。

choices.label: 以魂淬炼
choices.description: 失去大量生命，获得一张本职业橙色卡牌
choices.outcomeText: 你将灵魂投入熔心，痛楚换来一段足以焚毁强敌的传说技艺。
choices.description_en: Lose major HP, gain a class Legendary card.
choices.outcomeText_en: You cast your soul into the forge; agony buys you a legendary art that burns through mighty foes.

choices.label: 双重锻打
choices.description: 花20金币，随机升级一张卡（任意）
choices.outcomeText: 熔心的烈焰反复锻打你的一张技艺，使其脱胎换骨。
choices.description_en: Spend 20 gold to upgrade a random card.
choices.outcomeText_en: The forge hammers one of your skills again and again, reforging it anew.

choices.label: 押注余烬
choices.description: 失去生命换取更多金币
choices.outcomeText: 你赤手探入熔心，灼伤换来一捧价值惊人的炽热余烬。
choices.description_en: Lose HP to gain even more gold.
choices.outcomeText_en: You plunge your hands into the forge; the burns earn you a handful of precious embers.

choices.label: 退避热浪
choices.description: 热浪太盛，暂且退开
choices.outcomeText: 熔心的热浪逼人，你选择不与之纠缠。
choices.description_en: The heat is too much; step away.
choices.outcomeText_en: The forge's heat is overwhelming; you choose not to tangle with it.

description_en: In the deepest flames roars an ever-burning forge heart. Arts tempered here are said to incinerate all.

title: 冰封王座
description: 神殿尽头，一具坐于冰封王座上的远古亡王凝视着你。它的力量仍在，等待一个继承者，或一个祭品。

choices.label: 继承王权
choices.description: 失去16点生命，获得一张本职业红色卡牌
choices.outcomeText: 亡王的寒霜灌入你的血脉，你继承了它沉睡千年的神话之力。
choices.description_en: Lose 16 HP, gain a class Mythic card.
choices.outcomeText_en: The dead king's frost floods your veins; you inherit its mythic power, asleep for a thousand years.

choices.label: 冰封誓约
choices.description: 献上40金币，永久提升生命上限 +15
choices.outcomeText: 你立下冰封誓约，亡王的庇护让你的躯体如寒冰般坚韧持久。
choices.description_en: Offer 40 gold to permanently raise max HP by 15.
choices.outcomeText_en: You swear the frozen oath; the king's protection makes your body as enduring as ice.

choices.label: 击碎王冠
choices.description: 移除一张随机基础卡，并获得本职业紫色卡牌
choices.outcomeText: 你击碎冰封王冠，散落的霜晶中凝结出一张属于你的强大技艺，旧日的累赘也随之消融。
choices.description_en: Remove a random basic card and gain a class Epic card.
choices.outcomeText_en: You shatter the frozen crown; from the scattered frost a powerful skill forms, and old dead weight melts away.

choices.label: 俯首退离
choices.description: 不惊扰沉睡的亡王
choices.outcomeText: 你向亡王俯首，悄然退出王座大厅。
choices.description_en: Do not disturb the slumbering king.
choices.outcomeText_en: You bow to the dead king and slip out of the throne hall.

description_en: At the temple's end, an ancient dead king upon a frozen throne watches you—awaiting an heir, or a sacrifice.

title: 虚空终焉祭坛
description: 混沌深渊的核心，一座以虚空本身铸成的祭坛悬浮于无尽黑暗之上。它低语着：献祭，或被献祭。

choices.label: 拥抱虚空
choices.description: 失去大量生命与手牌上限，获得一张本职业红色卡牌
choices.outcomeText: 虚空吞噬了你的一部分，作为交换，无可匹敌的神话之力在掌心成形。
choices.description_en: Lose major HP and -1 hand size, gain a class Mythic card.
choices.outcomeText_en: The void devours part of you; in exchange, unmatched mythic power forms in your palm.

choices.label: 虚空飞升
choices.description: 献上48金币，永久提升生命上限 +18 与能量上限 +1
choices.outcomeText: 你将财富献给虚空，肉身与灵魂都被推向了全新的境界。
choices.description_en: Offer 48 gold to permanently raise max HP and max energy.
choices.outcomeText_en: You offer your wealth to the void; both body and soul are pushed to a new height.

choices.label: 孤注一掷
choices.description: 押上生命，极高风险换取一张通用红色卡牌
choices.outcomeText: 你押上了一切，虚空回报以神话之力，但深渊的目光已牢牢锁定你，伤痕深入骨髓。
choices.description_en: Wager your life: extreme risk for a generic Mythic card.
choices.outcomeText_en: You bet everything; the void rewards you with mythic power, but the abyss's gaze locks onto you and wounds bite to the bone.

choices.label: 拒绝献祭
choices.description: 不向虚空低头
choices.outcomeText: 你转身背对祭坛，拒绝成为虚空的一部分。
choices.description_en: Do not bow to the void.
choices.outcomeText_en: You turn your back on the altar, refusing to become part of the void.

description_en: At the abyss's core floats an altar forged from the void itself. It whispers: sacrifice, or be sacrificed.
